templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit in a circle, 4 face inward and 4 face outward alternately. [P1] faces inward and is 3rd to right of [P5] (outward). [P3] is 2nd to left of [P1] (both inward). [P7] faces outward and is opposite [P3]. [P2] is immediate right of [P7]. [P6] faces inward and is between [P4] (outward) and [P8] (outward). Who sits 3rd to the left of [P2]?
templates.explanation: Mixed inward/outward circle. Solving step by step: [P6] is 3rd to left of [P2] in the final arrangement

templates.pattern: Twelve persons [P1]-[P12] sit in two rows of 6. Row 1 faces north, Row 2 faces south. [P1] is 4th from left in Row 1. [P7] faces [P1]. [P3] is 2nd to right of [P1] in Row 1. [P9] is 2nd to left of [P7] in Row 2. [P5] is at the extreme right of Row 1. [P11] faces [P5]. [P2] is between [P1] and [P3]. [P8] faces [P2]. Who is at extreme left of Row 2?
templates.explanation: Row1: [P4]-[P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P6]-[P5]. Row2(mirror): [P11]-[P7]-[P8]-[P9]-[P12]-[P10]→reversed. Extreme left of Row2 = [P10]

templates.pattern: Ten persons sit in two parallel rows of 5. Row X faces east (persons [P1]-[P5]). Row Y faces west (persons [P6]-[P10]). [P1] faces [P6]. [P3] is 3rd from left in Row X. [P8] is 2nd to right of [P6] in Row Y. [P4] is to immediate right of [P3]. [P2] faces [P8]. [P9] is 3rd from right in Row Y. [P5] is immediate right of [P4]. [P10] is immediate right of [P9]. Who faces [P5]?

Nine persons [P1]-[P9] sit around a circular table. Some face inward, some outward. [P1] faces outward and is 4th to right of [P9] who faces inward. [P2] faces inward and is 2nd to right of [P1]. [P5] faces outward and is opposite [P2]. [P3] and [P6] are immediate neighbours of [P5]. [P3] faces inward. [P4] is 3rd to left of [P9]. [P7] is between [P4] and [P6] going anticlockwise. [P8] is immediate right of [P9]. How many face inward?
templates.explanation: Solving 9-person mixed direction arrangement: 5 face inward ([P2],[P3],[P4],[P7],[P9])

templates.pattern: Six persons [P1]-[P6] are seated in a row. [P2] is to the right of [P5] but to the left of [P4]. [P1] is to the left of [P3] but to the right of [P6]. [P5] is to the left of [P1]. [P3] is to the left of [P4]. [P6] is not at the extreme left. Who is at position 4 from the left?

Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit around a circular table facing inward. [P1] is 3rd to right of [P4]. [P2] is not adjacent to [P4] or [P1]. [P5] is 2nd to left of [P3]. [P3] is 4th to right of [P1]. [P6] is between [P4] and [P7] (going clockwise from [P4]). [P8] is immediate right of [P2]. What is the position of [P7] relative to [P2] going clockwise?
templates.explanation: Solving 8-person circular: [P7] is 3rd to right of [P2] going clockwise

templates.pattern: Seven persons [P1]-[P7] sit in a row. [P4] is 3 places to the right of [P7]. [P2] is 2 places to the left of [P5]. [P1] is to the immediate right of [P5] and to the immediate left of [P6]. [P3] is to the immediate left of [P7]. If [P4] is at position [A] from right, what position is [P3] from the left?
templates.explanation: Order: [P3]-[P7]-[P2]-[P5]-[P1]-[P6]-[P4]. [P3] is at position 1 from left

templates.pattern: Ten persons [P1]-[P10] sit in two rows of 5. Row A faces south. Row B faces north. [P1] is 3rd from right in Row A. [P6] faces [P1]. [P2] is immediate right of [P1] in Row A. [P7] is 2nd to left of [P6] in Row B. [P3] is 2nd to left of [P1] in Row A. [P8] faces [P3]. [P4] is at extreme right of Row A. [P5] is immediate left of [P3]. [P9] is immediate right of [P8]. [P10] faces [P4]. Who faces [P5]?

Six persons [P1]-[P6] of different professions (Doctor, Engineer, Teacher, Lawyer, CA, Pilot) sit in a row. The Doctor is 3rd from left. The Engineer is to the immediate right of the Doctor. [P1] is the Lawyer and is at the extreme left. [P3] is the Pilot. [P3] is 2nd to right of [P5] who is the Teacher. [P4] is the CA. Who is the Doctor?

Eight friends [P1]-[P8] sit around a circular table. [P1] is 4th to right of [P5]. [P8] is 3rd to left of [P5]. [P2] is between [P1] and [P8] (going clockwise from [P1]). [P3] is opposite [P2]. [P6] is 2nd to right of [P3]. [P7] is between [P5] and [P4] going clockwise. How many persons sit between [P6] and [P8] going anticlockwise?
templates.explanation: Solving 8-person circular: between [P6] and [P8] anticlockwise = 3 persons

templates.pattern: [N] persons sit in a row. [P1] is [A]th from left, [P2] is [B]th from right, [P3] is exactly between them. [P4] is [K] places to the right of [P3]. [P5] is [M] places to the left of [P4]. [P6] is to the immediate right of [P2]. What is [P6]'s rank from left?
templates.explanation: [P6] is immediate right of [P2]. [P2] from left = N-B+1. [P6] from left = N-B+2... but here [P6] is right, so pos = N-B+1+1 = N-B+2. Wait: from left = (N-B+1)+1 = N-B+2
